TNT Gender Reveal Rental Simple, Flexible and Stress Free

When you book our TNT Gender Reveal Rental, you are reserving the equipment for your selected event day but we know party days can be busy, so we have built in extra time for your peace of mind.

With every 1 day rental, you automatically receive a complimentary additional 24 hours to return the equipment. This means no rushing, no pressure and plenty of time to pack everything up safely after your celebration.

How it works

• Select your event date as your rental day

• Use the equipment for your celebration

• Enjoy an extra 24 hours after your event to return it completely stress free

We want your focus to be on celebrating, not watching the clock 🎉

If you have any questions about timing or returns, our team is always here to help so you can book with total confidence.
